candidates.name: Get information about property and land: overview
verified_facts: The guidance routes users to title registers, title plans, deeds and index-map searches depending on the information needed.
The available information is registration and documentary information about property and land.
semantic_limits: Property-information services do not themselves measure parcel terrain or establish a vertical error budget.

candidates.name: How to read a title register and title plan collection
verified_facts: HM Land Registry groups register-reading and title-plan-reading guidance to explain the distinct documentary and graphical components of a registered title.
The collection directs users to separate explanations for legal register entries and title-plan graphics.
semantic_limits: Guidance explaining registered documents is not a parcel survey and cannot raise elevation confidence without measurement lineage.
